difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with its three assertions for the deformation problem of a morphism of ringed spaces: a canonical class xi in Ext^2_{O_X}(L_{X/S}, G) whose vanishing is necessary and sufficient for solvability; principal homogeneity of the isomorphism classes of solutions under Ext^1_{O_X}(L_{X/S}, G); and the identification of the automorphism group of a solution with Ext^0_{O_X}(L_{X/S}, G) (source lines 3836-3851). Parts (2) and (3) come from deformation theory through the identifications NL_{X/S} = tau_{>=-1}L_{X/S} and H^0(L_{X/S}) = Omega_{X/S}. Part (1) takes the deformation-theoretic class xi' in Ext^1(Lf^*NL_{S/S'}, G), rewrites the naive complexes as full cotangent complexes, and uses the long exact sequence of the distinguished triangle for X -> S -> S' to see that solvability is exactly the condition that xi' lie in the image of the comparison map, so its image xi in Ext^2 is the obstruction.
